## Description

Implements the risk-review activity (S11) for entity and group investment review: consolidates open legal findings from DD into a register with severity and mitigation status for the IC package. Does not perform legal due diligence (legal-due-diligence) or statute research (k-law). Use when: "legal risk register", "legal issues", "risk register", "IC legal risk summary".
